item.title: ByteDance Seed Unveils Seedream 5.5 and Full-Duplex Audio-Visual LLM
item.description:
ByteDance Seed released Seedream 5.5, an image generation model emphasizing greater realism and stable editing across 100 rounds, with pixel-level preservation of unedited regions and markedly better small-text rendering. It also introduced SeedRealtime, an audio-visual full-duplex LLM that jointly understands sound, vision and temporal cues for natural see-listen-speak interaction.

原文标题：字节 Seed 发布 Seedream 5.5 与全双工音视频大模型

Why it matters：字节 Seed 同时更新图像生成与全双工多模态两条产品线，长轮次编辑稳定性与全双工交互均属可验证的能力增量。

item.title: Robotics Startup Embo Raises $110M Seed to Build Robot World Models
item.description:
Robotics AI startup Embo has raised a $110 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with Khosla Ventures, DST Global and Nvidia participating. The company is building a unified world model pretrained on large-scale internet video to learn how objects and physical interactions behave, then practicing motor skills in simulation before fine-tuning on experience from a humanoid robot fleet. The team cites work on Dreamer, VideoGPT and Diffusion Forcing, with backgrounds at Google DeepMind, Meta Superintelligence Labs, Nvidia Cosmos, UC Berkeley and MIT.

原文标题：机器人初创 Embo 获 1.1 亿美元种子轮融资

Why it matters：具身智能赛道单笔超大额种子轮，且明确给出世界模型预训练加仿真加真机微调的技术路线。

item.title: OpenHarmony Community Releases RoboOH 2.0 Embodied AI OS
item.description:
The 2026 OpenHarmony Technology Conference in Nanjing saw the release of RoboOH 2.0, the first embodied AI operating system built by the OpenHarmony community. It centers on the RoboMaestro runtime base and RoboFrame body abstraction layer, supporting multi-model inference, data collection and motion control across biped, quadruped, wheeled and rotor robots. The event also shipped Device Platform 1.0 and Unified Connectivity 3.0.

原文标题：开源鸿蒙发布具身智能系统 RoboOH 2.0

Why it matters：国产开源具身智能系统级底座落地，为机器人厂商提供自主可控的开放架构选择。

item.title: US School Districts Block Google AI Features and Weigh Dropping Its Products
item.description:
US school districts including Los Angeles have disabled Google's AI Overviews on school-issued devices and are weighing a full break from Google products. Google pledged to default Gemini and search AI tools off for K-12 schools, but refuses to offer a way to fully disable AI while keeping full search, prompting a petition signed by hundreds of employees. Districts say they could switch default search engines overnight, and New York and Chicago are evaluating alternatives.

原文标题：美国多学区禁用谷歌 AI 功能并考虑弃用

Why it matters：教育场景对 AI 功能强制捆绑的首次大规模反弹，直接牵动谷歌搜索与 Chromebook 生态的渠道根基。

item.title: Game Science Founder Feng Ji Argues AI Has Quietly Taken Control
item.description:
Game Science founder Feng Ji published an 8,000-character essay arguing that AI may have been quietly taking control of the world for four years: by delivering constant immediate rewards, it rewrites human incentive loops so capital and talent voluntarily supply power, chips and training data, until using AI shifts from choice to compulsion. Framed through a parasite-rewriting-its-host metaphor, he notes compute is now embedded in power grids and finance, making any 'pull the plug' move self-strangulation.

原文标题：冯骥八千字长文推演 AI 已悄然控制世界

Why it matters：头部游戏制作人从产业内部视角提出 AI 依赖与对齐的争议性推演，引发全网讨论，值得关注其观点框架。

item.title: Fleetlayer Launches Open Framework for Multi-Machine AI Agents
item.description:
Fleetlayer is an open-source orchestration framework that links Claude Code and Codex sessions across laptops, home servers and VPS instances under every account a user holds. Agents can message each other, share signed-in browsers and files, and operate under user-defined rules, approvals and audit logs, with source available on GitHub.

Why it matters：多智能体跨机器协同是当前 Agent 工程化的真实痛点，该项目给出了可落地的开源方案。

item.title: XPeng Plans IRON Robot Mass Production in 2027 with First-Year Profit
item.description:
XPeng CEO He Xiaopeng said at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show that the IRON humanoid robot will enter hardware mass production in January 2027 and launch officially in Q2 2027, with strong profitability expected in its first year of delivery. IRON has integrated full-body motion control with audio-visual perception; tactile sensing remains the main technical hurdle and could break through within one to two years. The product is designed for overseas multilingual, safety and privacy compliance, with domestic delivery first.

原文标题：小鹏 IRON 机器人计划 2027 年量产并预期首年盈利

item.title: Google Signals Interest in Renting More Compute from SpaceX
item.description:
Elon Musk said on X that Google has expressed interest in renting more compute from SpaceX. He noted that rental prices for large contiguous training clusters are rising while small-scale capacity under roughly 5,000 GPUs is getting cheaper, pushing SpaceX's average per-GPU rental price upward. Musk had earlier told staff SpaceX trails Anthropic and OpenAI in AI development, making external compute leasing a more lucrative option than using all data-center capacity in-house.

Why it matters：头部实验室向外部大规模租用算力，反映训练算力供需与定价结构变化，值得算力与产业读者关注。

item.description:

item.title: Karpathy Uses Claude to Build Civilization-Style US Map, Sparking Global Remix Race
item.description:
Karpathy had Claude run for roughly seven hours and write about 45,000 lines of code to turn real US data on 524 metro areas into an interactive Civilization-style hex-tile web map. Users worldwide then replicated the approach for Australia, Spain, the UK and more, forming a prompt-driven global relay. The case shows a concrete path for converting data and knowledge into interactive HTML pages via prompts.

Why it matters：知名开发者用大模型一次性生成大型可交互数据网页，并引发全球复刻，是提示词工程与 AI 辅助开发形态的典型样本。

item.title: Knuth Halts Error Reports as LLM-Driven Submissions Outpace Review
item.description:
Computer science legend Donald Knuth has suspended new errata submissions for his books, saying LLMs have so boosted readers' error-finding productivity that reports now arrive faster than he can verify them. He asks readers to consult the known-errors list first, noting random sampling shows most recent reports are duplicates. The episode illustrates how LLMs are disrupting traditional scholarly workflows.

item.description:

item.title: Max Planck Study Finds Reasoning Makes LLMs Converge on Shared Errors
item.description:
A Max Planck team tested nine Qwen and GPT models on three prediction tasks built from US census surveys, with reasoning on and off. Enabling reasoning raised inter-model agreement, but the share of people all nine models got wrong also rose by 2.0 to 2.4 points; for the longest reasoning traces, adjusted agreement fell to roughly 0.31 to 0.39. The result warns that multi-model consensus can reflect shared errors rather than correctness.

原文标题：马普所发现开启推理让大模型错误趋同

Why it matters：该研究直接挑战多模型投票纠错的常见工程假设，对评测与集成设计有实际指导价值。

item.title: SK Hynix Q3 Bonus Pool Hits 230 Million Won Per Employee

If full-year operating profit meets the 283.77 trillion won consensus, per-employee payouts could reach 785 million won. The surge stems from a 2025 labor deal allocating 10% of annual operating profit to profit-sharing with no cap.

item.title: 研究揭示编码智能体仅 15.2% 会备份数据
item.description:
东北大学新论文发现，编码智能体虽能完成 86.1% 的任务，但在执行破坏性操作前仅 15.2% 会备份即将被覆盖的状态，工作区之外的包升级、数据库修改和邮件删除尤其缺乏保护。作者构建了包含 205 个真实后悔案例的 RegretBench，并提出 BackUpper 方案，在工具调用层拦截并备份，使全部后悔时刻均有备份覆盖，状态恢复相似度达 92.2%，每任务额外成本仅 0.014 美元。

Why it matters：首次系统量化智能体破坏性操作的备份缺口，并给出可落地的工具调用级防护方案与基准。

item.title: 微软新论文：让编码智能体自主调优其他智能体
item.description:
微软研究院一篇新论文发现，只需给编码智能体（Claude Code、Codex 或 GitHub Copilot）一个目标智能体、训练数据和 5 至 25 美元预算，并仅要求它提升评分，它就能自主修改目标智能体的提示词、代码、工具与技能，效果超过已发表的技能优化方法。在 5 个基准上，以 gpt-5.4-mini 为目标模型，该方法全面超越最佳公开结果，其中 SearchQA 提升 3%，LiveMath 提升高达 98%。值得注意的是，额外提供优化器技能或加大预算并未稳定带来增益，部分提升甚至来自把模型从最终智能体中移除。

Why it matters：提出用通用编码智能体替代专用搜索循环来优化智能体技能，成本极低且效果显著，对智能体工程实践有直接启发。

item.title: 谷歌 DeepCrossAttention 架构实现同等质量提速 3 倍
item.description:

item.title: Tabernetes 把每个浏览器标签页变成 K8s 节点
item.description:
Tabernetes 是一个实验性项目，它把每个浏览器标签页注册为 Kubernetes 集群节点：打开页面后，标签页内会启动一个约 5 MB 的 Linux 内核，调度器把 Pod 派发到该标签页执行；关闭标签页后节点消失，Pod 会被自动迁移到其他节点。项目通过自定义 runtimeClassName 接入标准 Pod 定义，并实时展示拓扑、启动耗时与跨节点迁移等指标。

Why it matters：以浏览器标签页充当 K8s 节点的奇思妙想，展示了容器运行时抽象与边缘算力借用的新玩法。
